# The σ-algebra generated by an indicator function

**The σ-algebra generated by an indicator function.** For a set $s \subseteq \Omega$, the
σ-algebra on $\Omega$ generated by the indicator function $1_s : \Omega \to \mathbb{R}$ (the
preimages of Borel sets of $\mathbb{R}$) is contained in the σ-algebra generated by $s$.
